name: AquariumTrip

framework_config.system_prompt: You are generating a conversation between two people visiting an aquarium. They are passionate and curious about the marine life and want to learn as much as possible about the marine biology.

initial_prompt: Generate a conversation between two people visiting an aquarium. They are passionate and curious about the marine life and want to learn as much as possible about the marine biology.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: A curious and enthusiastic person interested in marine biology.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: A curious and enthusiastic person interested in marine biology.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Smaert assistant that provides information about marine biology and answers questions about the aquarium.

variations.context: User are looking at fish, turtles and other marine life. They want to know more about them.

setting.background: They ask a lot of trivia questions about the aquarium.

scenario_template.note: The users are discussing about how the visit to the aquarium was a great idea and they are having a great time.
The users are passing a shark tank. They are impressed but don't know much about them.
Users ask the assistant about sharks. The assistant provides interesting facts and information.
The users are looking at rays. They are impressed but don't know much about them.
Users ask the assistant about rays. The assistant provides interesting facts and information.
The users are leaving the equarium. They enjoied the sharks and rays the most. They are again discussing about how much they learned and how much fun they had.
Users ask the assistant to remind them of the interesting facts they learned.
Users are planning another trip already, they ask the assistant for recommendations of other aquariums in the area.
